text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) 2023.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 15 Januari 2023 hingga 29 Januari 2023.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Ikan bawal putih (berat antara 200 gram hingga 400 gram seekor)

2. Udang putih (berat antara 41 ekor hingga 60 ekor sekilogram)

3. Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China, tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

4. Babi hidup

5. Daging babi (perut)

6. Daging babi (daging dan lemak)

Dibuat 9 Januari 2023

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/Jld. 13]

 DATUK SERI SALAHUDDIN BIN AYUB

 Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Kos Sara Hidup

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) ORDER 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the

Control of Supplies Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

Order 2023.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles

for the period from 15 January 2023 to 29 January 2023.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. White pomfret (weight ranges between 200 grams to 400 grams each)

2. Banana prawn (weight ranges between 41 prawns to 60 prawns

per kilogram)

3. Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China, not including

Beijing cabbage)

4. Live pig

5. Pork (belly)

6. Pork (lean and fat)

Made 9 January 2023

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/Jld. 13]

 DATUK SERI SALAHUDDIN BIN AYUB

 Minister of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living
